title: ABLEfid
tagline: Proof of Concept: Better yields for people with Social Securities Income
description:
With government starting to create regulations around crypto currency, we need to bring a spotlight to the possibilities that stable coin yields can give to fiduciaries and beneficiaries to passively generate income on chain! We wanted to really demonstrate the possibilities this could  have, impact wise to the Disabilities and Accessibility Communities.

This was only a very rough draft of every idea we had during the process, and something we are PROUD to present to everyone at ETH Global.
how_its_made: The project is a simple web app with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript at its base, with the Stable Coin purchasing application was built using Flow's extensive NetWork to create our "StableCoin". We created another application that exchanges USDC on Sepolia into Ethereum as a Proof of Concept using UniSwap Hooks. We also were able to develop and execute a smart contract utilizing Hashgraph and Hedera's AI, but didn't have enough time during the 36 hours to really implement into our application, but the code and screenshots are available on GitHub.
